Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Thank you for considering employment with Air Force Services Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF). This position provides an opportunity to join the Wright-Patterson Air Force Base community and enjoy the many perks of being part of the team! Take advantage of activities offered through Outdoor Recreation, spend some time at the Bowling Alley, hit up a Golf Course or one of the Gyms, do some shopping at the Base Exchange, then grab a bite to eat from one of the Base Restaurants or seasonal food trucks. For those looking for personal development opportunities, courses covering a multitude of topics are available year-round. In addition, the NAF Tuition Assistance Program is available to current NAF employees with at least one year of federal service. As part of the Wright-Patterson community, we want our NAF employees to experience all there is to offer!
MajorDuties: Responsible for the efficient operation of the Consolidated Hobby Shop to include but not limited to financial management, workforce supervision, and program development. Supervise a diverse work force to include personnel in the wood, framing, T-shirt, engraving, auto hobby program and car wash operation. Monitors personnel and contract staff to ensure orders & customer demands are being processed in a timely and cost-effective manner. Develops operating goals and objectives, which include a marketing and program plan on an annual basis. Uses customer feedback and comment cards to develop annual survey. Uses survey data to obtain optimum programming and goals for each sector of the activity. Develops/executes procedures to regularly evaluate results of operations and takes corrective actions. Direct or performs special studies and analysis designed to resolve operational problems. Coordinates with base agencies, i.e., safety, civil engineers, and environment to resolve problems and improve program safety. Maintains a regular schedule of preventive maintenance and replacement of equipment and supplies. Inspects for cleanliness and to make sure all safety equipment is available. Ensures personnel are trained and able to promote safety to all customers and patrons using hazardous equipment. Monitors proper hazardous material/waste collection, storage, and disposal. Supervise personnel, verifies daily clean up, and safety inspections are performed. Does periodic safety checks of equipment, employees, and patrons. Ensures employees are acculturated to the unit activity mission. Provides a regular schedule of employee training. Provides classes and self directed activities for adults and children. Ensures all classes are meeting the instructional goals set of the operation. Publicizes classes and monitors all instructors' contracted of direct staff. Ensures classroom space and supplies are available to effectively conduct classes. Attends base training and meeting pertaining to the latest updates on waste management and disposal. Inspects facilities for compliance on a regular basis. Develops processes and procedures to manage and protect Non-Appropriated Fund (NAF) and appropriated (APF) assets IAW Air Force and local policy/guidance. Prepares NAF budgets annually. Analyzes financial performance and develops processes and procedures to ensure the center maintains a positive financial bottom line at all times. Ensures all daily, weekly, monthly, and annual administrative and financial requirements are met. Works with Resource Management Flight Chief to ensure internal controls are monitored. Informs flight chief of any major customer problems and concerns. May be required to work outside normal business. Hours. May be subject to irregular tour of duty. All other duties as assigned. *This vacancy is subject to closing early if qualified applicants have applied.* Applicant reviews will be completed weekly or biweekly during this announcement period. Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Thank you for considering employment with Air Force Services Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF). This position provides an opportunity to join the Wright-Patterson Air Force Base community and enjoy the many perks of being part of the team! Take advantage of activities offered through Outdoor Recreation, spend some time at the Bowling Alley, hit up a Golf Course or one of the Gyms, do some shopping at the Base Exchange, then grab a bite to eat from one of the Base Restaurants or seasonal food trucks. For those looking for personal development opportunities, courses covering a multitude of topics are available year-round. In addition, the NAF Tuition Assistance Program is available to current NAF employees with at least one year of federal service. As part of the Wright-Patterson community, we want our NAF employees to experience all there is to offer!
MajorDuties: Types of duties include, but are not limited to the following: Carries out recurring group activities such as classes, clubs, special events, outreach, competitive games and events, and self-directed leisure. Recommends new programming activities, to include type of format and resources the activity would require. Gathers information from a number of different sources, including past programs and current popular programs in other communities. Evaluates the information and makes a judgment on what meets the needs of the specific clientele groups. Assists individuals with special interests to develop clubs or special interest groups. Assists in promoting marketing strategies. During deployment, exercises, and other special conditions, leads leisure activities and assists with services. Sets up rooms to support meeting group needs. Collects fees and protects funds. Greets facility users and conducts facility tours. Decorates facility to reflect holiday and program themes. Reports facility repairs and maintenance requirements according to procedures. Assists in maintaining facility to meet operational standards. Works with other staff members, volunteer and/or individual/personal services contract personnel. Performs other related duties as required. Skilled or proficient in surf lifesaving techniques and radio communications to perform a safe and efficient rescue operation. Ability to exercise control over a large group of people. Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Details.JobSummary: This position is assigned to the Non-Appropriated Fund (NAF), Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka. Incumbent provides lifeguard duties; is responsible for safeguarding the lives of persons at the assigned work area; assists with Aquatic training, education, and general support at the installation. This announcement is open continuous, it is open year-round. CNRJ Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: CNIC offers innovative, exciting and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. CNIC provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. The mission of the Fleet and Family Readiness (FFR) Programs is to maximize the physical, emotional and social development of the fleet, fighter and family. FFR enables a ready Navy force through its Fleet Readiness, Family Readiness, and Housing Programs. We provide direct and support services to all non-appropriated fund (NAF) employees who work for Morale, Welfare and Recreation (MWR) throughout the FFR Program worldwide.
MajorDuties: Performs all pool and/or waterfront lifeguard responsibilities (e.g., supervising swimmers/patrons and their activities, monitoring all natural water activities, applying first aid, enforcing safety rules, reporting safety hazards to supervisor, performing water rescues as necessary, etc.). Observes conditions of area assigned (e.g., possible hazards, water/chemical conditions, wind and weather, etc.) to ensure a safe environment, removing hazardous materials when necessary (e.g., floating debris, glass, etc.). Performs rescue work, promptly renders cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) or emergency first aid and calls for medical assistance as necessary. Conducts and documents pool chemical testing results. Checks chlorine and pH levels on a scheduled basis; notifies Certified Pool Operator or supervisor of chemical imbalances; adjusts chemicals as directed. Documents marine life, water conditions and weather conditions. Administers aquatic assessment testing and certification in accordance with Department of Defense (DoD), Department of the Navy (DON) and CNIC policy. Provides introductory equipment orientations, as needed. Checks identification cards for authorized patrons and collects usage fees, if applicable. Serves as the primary liaison between the activity, security, medical departments, and Aquatics Coordinator during emergency situations. Performs cleaning duties (e.g., basic janitorial services, vacuuming, skimming, etc.) and routine facility maintenance as assigned by Aquatics Coordinator. Inspects stands, boards, ropes, safety gear and condition of the dressing rooms, ensuring they are within the condition required by environmental health standards. Informs supervisor of deficiencies. Uses and maintains care of emergency equipment (e.g., specialized kits and bags, backboards, suction devices, splints, stretchers, monitoring equipment, etc.). Enforces applicable policies and procedures of Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) regarding the use of Aquatic facilities and waterfront operations. Prepares accident/incident reports during emergency situations. Notifies management of all emergencies immediately. Works with hazardous materials (e.g., cleaning agents, pool chemicals, etc.).

Foreign education must include evidence that it is comparable to education received at accredited educational institutions in the United States. Transcripts from foreign colleges must be evaluated for U.S. equivalency in order to be considered. Credential evaluations are not free and applicants are responsible for the cost of the selected service. To receive consideration for a non-related degree or eligibility based on a combination of education AND experience, a college transcript is required. All transcripts MUST show student's name and the name of the awarding university or educational institution, degree type, awarded/conferred date, and the field of study. *If your degree has not been awarded/conferred, you must provide a copy of your HS Diploma or equivalent along with transcript(s). Only attendance and/or degrees from schools accredited by accrediting institutions recognized by the U.S. Department of Education are acceptable to meet positive education requirements or to substitute education for experience. For additional information, please go to the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and the U.S. Department of Education websites at http://www.opm.gov/qualifications and http://www.ed.gov/admins/finaid/accred/index.html

Ensures athletic playing surfaces are properly maintained, safe, and ready for play. Assists in properly cleaning and maintaining equipment/facilities, maintains inventory, performs general janitorial services to ensure interior spaces are in a clean, neat, and orderly state at all times (e.g., sweeping and mopping floors; dusting and cleaning workout areas, mirrors, bathrooms, and locker areas; straightening equipment and accessories, etc.). Reports maintenance problems, material deficiencies, and unsafe conditions or discrepancies that cannot be repaired in-house to the supervisor.

Details.JobSummary: This position is located in the Travel & Tours Office, MWR Department, Fleet Activities, Yokosuka, Japan.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: CNIC offers innovative, exciting, and meaningful work linking military and civilian talents to achieve our mission and safeguard our freedoms. CNIC provides competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and extensive professional development and training. The mission of the Fleet and Family Readiness (FFR) Programs is to maximize the physical, emotional, and social development of the fleet, fighter, and family. FFR enables a ready Navy force through its Fleet Readiness, Family Readiness, and Housing Programs. We provide direct and support services to all non-appropriated fund (NAF) employees who work for Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) throughout the FFR Program worldwide.
MajorDuties: Plans, develops and administers a comprehensive and versatile tour/ transportation program, for military personnel and their dependents, authorized DOD civilians, and retired military personnel. Administers the operation of an entertainment ticket office that provides for cultural, sporting, and entertainment attractions primarily in the greater Kanto area, but also throughout Japan and the Far East region. Establishes and maintains close working relationship with all major tour operators, airlines, cruise lines, independent travel operator, restaurants, hotels/motels, and attractions, and conduct thorough surveys and analysis in planning and schedule of tours. Through negotiation, ensures that the highest quality tours are available at the lowest group/military discount prices. Periodically acts as tour escort or individually investigate tour destination to ensure maximum success and patron satisfaction. Packages, prices and schedules tours to meet anticipated demand and according to availability of destination, costs, and probability of success. Ensures that tour selection is of such variety as to appeal to the wide spectrum of the total military community and include tours of entertainment, cultural and educational value. Ensures that all initial tour bookings are arranged and all final arrangements, i.e., payment, rooming lists, manifests, escort instructions, etc., are completed and submitted in an efficient and timely manner. Maintains quality control of tours by conducting periodic oral and written surveys of patrons. Implements proper budgetary accounting policies that provide effective cost control measures that ensure budget guidelines are met and that a minimum self-sufficiency of 100% is maintained for the tours and transportation program. Works with the MWR Marketing Office in developing marketing and promotional material to properly advertise the program. This will include public presentations to groups and conducting pre-tour events. Prepares and publishes comprehensive tour bulletin every quarter. Supervises and trains subordinate staff, to include customer service personnel, travel information clerks, tour guides, Incumbent must present a neat, well-groomed, professional appearance at all times and must work harmoniously with co-workers and members of the MWR Department. Performs supervisory duties which include assigning work, defining priorities, selecting and recommending applicants for hire, evaluating performance, recommending pay adjustments/awards, providing or recommending training, approving and/or disapproving leave requests, initiating corrective actions, and recommending formal corrective/disciplinary actions as warranted Performs other related duties as assigned.

MajorDuties: Opens and secures facility. Ensures auditorium, concession area, and restrooms are clean prior to arrival of patrons. Ensures program operates according to CNIC instructions and CNIC Program standards, guidance, and requirements. Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Thank you for considering employment with Air Force Services Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF). The 374 Force Support Squadron is a team of 1,000+ military, civilians and local nationals. We work together to provide enhanced quality of life for the 12,000 Yokota Air Base community members and over 150,000 transient personnel that visit Yokota every year via facilities and programs centered on morale, welfare, recreation and total force development. Our operations are the fourth largest in the Air Force: 13 dining facilities; personnel readiness and accountability; lodging; fitness; recreation; resiliency; child and youth programs; community building; mortuary affairs; NEO; Professional Development; and Education and Training. The squadron is comprised of eight flights, 49 activities and 159 facilities.
MajorDuties: Performs a variety of food preparation tasks to assist cooks in the food preparation area by weighing, measuring, and assembling ingredients according to standardized recipes. Prepares a variety of uncooked food items, ingredients, side items, and garnishments and other ingredients. Assembles and tosses fresh fruit or green salads in quantity using prepared dressings, serves into standard serving sizes. Removes items from the walk-in cooler and washes, peals, slices, seeds or mashes and delivers to kitchen for further processing. Seasons and pans meats for roasting, breads and prepares chicken for frying. Slices cooked meats and prepares sandwiches. Wraps, arranges and packages fruits, vegetables, bread and condiments for carry-out. Prepares special salads, fruit trays, hors d' oeuvres, and desserts to accommodate unique groups, i.e., formal dining-ins, buffets and receptions. Measures and mixes ingredients such as cooked potatoes, hard-boiled eggs, pickles, onions, mustard, mayonnaise, seasonings and canned tuna in preparing salads, such as potato salad, tuna salad, or deviled eggs, etc. Prepares individual salads such as gelatin, fruit or tossed. Garnishes salads and delivers to kitchen/salad bar for serving. Prepares customer areas, tables, and side service stands with items such as napkins, straws, cup lids, condiments, and utensils. Maintains area in a neat and clean manner and replenishes items as necessary. Operates a dishwasher or manually washing (scrapes, soaks, scours and scrubs) bowls, pots and pans, glassware, beverage makers (coffee urns), and other utensils. Performs heavy duty cleaning tasks such as coffee machines; exhaust hoods; under and behind refrigerators/kitchen equipment or table areas; sweeping, washing, mopping and buffing floors, and washing walls; and sanitizes garbage cans. May unload food from delivery trucks. Collects and transfers trash from work area to disposal area. As required, accepts and submits food orders from customers. Operates a cash register, rings-up sales, and accept payments and processes changes to patrons. Prepares documentation for cash funds accountability and related cash records. Performs other related duties as assigned. If interested in this position please preview the online application: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/12885221
